results.title: Verizon FIOS customers see Starz channels blacked out
results.description: The premium cable channels have been pulled due to a carriage dispute, and we’ll explain the best ways to stream Starz content below. The stars are a little less bright for Verizon FIOS customers today. The pay-TV service has lost access to the Starz family of cable channels thanks to a carriage dispute, and if you’re a FIOS customer who values access to the premium cable channel and its sibling networks, we’ll explain which other services allow you to watch Starz below. Key Details: Going out: Starz has gone dark for Verizon Fios customers thanks to a carriage dispute. Your fault: Starz president Alison Hoffman has placed the blame for the outage at Verizon’s feet. Other choices: Starz is available direct-to-consumer, as well as through several live TV streaming . Sign Up $10.99+ / month Starz Starz put out a statement on Wednesday indicating that, though it had been “negotiating in good faith” with Verizon to ensure the carriage deal between the two sides did not expire, talks had hit a snag, and a blackout of the channels on Verizon FIOS was possible. Now, the worst has come to fruition for FIOS customers who love watching Starz. The main cable channel, as well as its associate networks, are all blacked out on Verizon FIOS as of Thursday morning, a clear indication that the two sides were unable to reach a carriage deal. Starz president Alison Hoffman issued a statement on Wednesday night putting the blame for the outage squarely at Verizon’s feet. “Despite extensive efforts by Starz to reach a renewal agreement and preserve uninterrupted access for Verizon Fios customers, Verizon has chosen to remove Starz,” Hoffman said. “Verizon has mischaracterized our position, shown an unwillingness to negotiate and has been unproductive in progressing towards a mutually beneficial outcome” The Streamable has reached out to Verizon for a statement, and will update this article if and when we receive a response. Any statement from Verizon is likely to at least imply that Starz was asking for carriage fees higher than it felt was reasonable to pay. Where to watch Starz now If you’re a Verizon FIOS customer who wants to restore access to Starz and don’t want to wait for the two companies to make nice, you can watch the channels in multiple ways. Our favorite is using the STARZ direct-to-consumer service, which normally costs $12 per month. This is the ideal way to replace Starz access for a limited window, and viewers can cancel as soon as Verizon and Starz make a new deal to restore carriage. Viewers can also find the Starz linear channel on a number of live TV streaming services. However, as a premium cable channel, Starz is usually placed in higher-priced packages or add-ons that require the user to buy a base package and then purchase the add-on as well. See how much it costs to add Starz to a live TV streaming package in the chart below. These streamers’ base packages range between $46 and $100+ per month, which means you’re only wise to pick one if you’re canceling Verizon FIOS. If so, DIRECTV is our favorite choice for watching Starz. Viewers can add Starz to an existing DIRECTV subscription a la carte for $12 per month, meaning viewers don’t have to buy it in an add-on package with other cable networks they may not watch. DIRECTV Signature packages start at $90 per month, and the service also sells a variety of genre-based channel plans. results.description: Generative AI is changing how consumers find, evaluate and purchase products.
